rules.unit: company balance-sheet date with reported total assets or total liabilities-and-equity
rules.description: Total assets must equal LiabilitiesAndStockholdersEquity within 0.1% (floor USD 1,000). Skipped when only one side is reported.

rules.unit: company balance-sheet date with reported liabilities-and-equity
rules.description: Reported total liabilities + total equity (incl. NCI) + temporary equity must equal LiabilitiesAndStockholdersEquity within 0.5%. Skipped when Liabilities is not reported (derived values would be tautological).

rules.unit: consolidated fact for a tag whose natural balance is non-negative (list in config/quality_rules.yaml)
rules.description: Assets, liabilities, inventory, receivables, cash, cost of revenue, capex and share counts must not be negative.

rules.unit: normalized revenue value (company, period, duration)
rules.description: Revenue should not be negative. Warn-level because RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense can legitimately be negative for financial firms.

rules.unit: company balance-sheet date with reported total assets
rules.description: Current assets cannot exceed total assets (0.1% tolerance). Skipped for unclassified balance sheets that report no current assets.

rules.unit: company balance-sheet date with total liabilities (reported or derived)
rules.description: Current liabilities cannot exceed total liabilities (0.1% tolerance). Skipped when no current liabilities are reported.

rules.unit: year-to-date flow value (company, metric, period end) for revenue, cost of revenue, operating income, net income, operating cash flow
rules.description: A year-to-date value must equal the previous year-to-date value plus the quarter: YTD(n) = YTD(n-1) + Q(n), within 0.5%. Skipped when either component is not reported (e.g. Q4 is almost never filed as a standalone quarter).

rules.unit: (company, metric, fiscal year) with a reported annual value
rules.description: Where all four standalone quarters are reported, they must sum to the annual value within 0.5%. Coverage is low because Q4 is rarely filed as a standalone quarter.

rules.unit: consolidated fact (company, tag, period, duration, unit) reported in two or more filings
rules.description: The same fact reported with materially different values (>0.1%) in different filings. Both values are kept in the restatements table; the later filing is authoritative.

rules.unit: original (non-amended) in-scope filing
rules.description: An original 10-K/10-Q that was later superseded by a 10-K/A or 10-Q/A for the same company and period. Computed from the data rather than the stale prevrpt flag.

rules.unit: original (non-amended) in-scope filing
rules.description: The same company filed the same form for the same period more than once without marking it as an amendment.

rules.unit: raw num.txt row (all forms, all quarters)
rules.description: Exact duplicates of the num.txt primary key (adsh, tag, version, ddate, qtrs, uom, segments, coreg) inside one dataset quarter. Every row of a duplicated key counts as a failure.

rules.unit: normalized monetary or share value (company, metric, period, duration)
rules.description: Value more than 5 robust sigmas from the company's own history for the same metric and duration (z = (x - median) / (1.4826 * MAD); mean absolute deviation fallback when MAD = 0). Skipped with fewer than 9 observations or a constant history.

rules.unit: 10-K / 10-Q filing that carries a balance sheet
rules.description: Every primary filing must report the mandatory canonical metrics for its form (config/mandatory_tags.yaml) after alias resolution; revenue is not required for financial-sector SICs, and only required when the filing reports cost of revenue or gross profit (pre-revenue and investment companies have no revenue line).

rules.unit: consolidated fact with a typed tag (monetary / shares / perShare / pure)
rules.description: The unit of measure must match the tag's datatype (monetary -> ISO currency, shares -> shares, perShare -> ISO currency (FSDS stores per-share units as the bare currency), pure -> pure); additionally a monetary tag must not be reported in two currencies inside one filing.

rules.unit: company flow period with a reported GrossProfit
rules.description: Revenue - cost of revenue must equal reported gross profit within 0.5%. Skipped when revenue or cost of revenue is not reported.

rules.unit: company flow period with reported operating cash flow
rules.description: Operating + investing + financing cash flow (+ FX effect) must equal the reported change in cash within 0.5%, pairing the including-FX or excluding-FX variant of the change-in-cash tag. Skipped when a component or the change-in-cash total is not reported.

rules.unit: company flow period with reported basic EPS
rules.description: Net income / weighted-average basic shares must agree with reported basic EPS within 5% (floor 0.01). Catches share counts or EPS reported at the wrong scale. Skipped when net income or basic shares are missing or zero.

rules.unit: in-scope filing
rules.description: Submission metadata must be coherent: period and filed present, fp in the allowed set, fy within one year of the period, period not after the filing date, and 10-K forms tagged fp = FY.

rules.unit: raw num.txt row and raw pre.txt row (all forms, all quarters)
rules.description: Every (tag, version) used in num.txt and pre.txt must exist in tag.txt, and every num.txt accession must exist in sub.txt.

rules.unit: modelled fact whose tag declares an instant/duration period type
rules.description: Instant tags (iord = I, balance-sheet items) must be reported with qtrs = 0. Duration tags with qtrs = 0 are skipped: FSDS rounds durations shorter than ~45 days (e.g. a share issuance on a single date) to zero quarters, so they cannot be judged.

rules.unit: consolidated monetary / share / per-share fact
rules.description: Values beyond physically plausible magnitudes (USD > 1e14, shares > 1e13, per-share > 1e5) indicate scaling errors in the filing.
